description_en: Retrieves the result set export configurations
description_zh: 获取用户配置的结果集导出信息
name: DescribeResultExportConfig

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to view the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口可以查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The export type. Valid values:

SLS: The export destination is SLS.
OSS: The export destination is OSS
parameters.help_zh:
导出类型，枚举类型，当前可选值为：

SLS：标识导出目的为SLS。
OSS：标识导出目的为OSS

ExportType.description_en:
The export type. Valid values:

SLS: The export destination is SLS.
OSS: The export destination is OSS
ExportType.description_zh:

OssInfo.description_en: The OSS information when the export type is OSS

ExportBasePath.description_en: The OSS path where the export results are stored

ResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the resource group in which the export SQL statement is executed

SlsInfo.description_en: The SLS configurations when the export type is SLS
SlsInfo.description_zh: 导出类型为SLS时，对应的SLS配置信息

LogstoreTtl.description_en: The expiration time of the temporarily generated Logstore for result set export. Unit: days. The Logstore is automatically deleted after it expires. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 30
LogstoreTtl.description_zh: 结果集导出临时生成的logstore的过期时间，单位为天，过期后自动删除。 最小1天，最大30天

ResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the resource group in which the export SQL statement is executed
